rationale: Build on the 9x512 recurrent-tail best by turning the earlier recurrent tail pass on in the forward path over the first part of the train budget while leaving the deepest recurrent pass active from the start. The recent gate-only warm-in was a close miss, so this pushes the same idea further: early steps train the proven deepest recurrence with less interference from the second shared pass, then the full two-block recurrent tail is restored well before the quant-aware endgame and exact final eval. The change is compile-stable, keeps artifact bytes unchanged, and directly targets the underexplored recurrence-scheduling category instead of another small optimizer sweep.
title: Forward-Mix Earlier Tail Recurrence Curriculum
